"""Prepare/apply reviewable lead metadata only after Root supplies actual gates.

Default invocation reads source/evidence and prints the pending input plan.
--gates stages evidence externally; --apply also requires Root authorization
inside that supplied receipt. This script never builds, tests, pushes or commits.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import base64
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import re
import shutil
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/workspace/android-studio-parallel-sync-policy')
BASE = Path('/workspace/android-studio-artifacts/parallel-sync-integration')
PREPARATION = BASE / 'metadata-preparation'
SOURCE = '4fb7a80eacc598a786b4b98c809d1df24a1b02ee'
TREE = '9659baeb98fcf7111435169eb04490ba3952989d'
CI_RUN = 37703317253
PATHS = ['.', ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/*.md',
         ':(exclude)docs/android-studio/reference-manifest.json',
         ':(exclude)docs/android-studio/test-parity.json',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/ports/*.json',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/evidence/**/*.log',
         ':(glob,exclude)docs/android-studio/evidence/**/*.json']
DESTINATION = Path('docs/android-studio/evidence/parallel-sync-policy-lead')


def sha(path):
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT)


def write_new(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('x') as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


def guard():
    assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == SOURCE
    assert git('rev-parse', SOURCE + '^{tree}').decode().strip() == TREE
    for cached in [False, True]:
        subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--quiet'] + (['--cached'] if cached else []) +
                       [SOURCE, '--', *PATHS], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    assert not git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', *PATHS)
    expected = json.loads((BASE / 'runtime/whole-source-static-guard.json').read_text())
    assert expected['fixed_source_pathspec'] == PATHS and len(expected['files']) == 4730
    assert all(sha(ROOT / path) == digest for path, digest in expected['files'].items())
    owner_manifest = read(ROOT / 'docs/android-studio/evidence/parallel-sync-policy/manifest.json')
    assert owner_manifest['source_commit'] == '63c88dcf0eb7364521c5ea79b8cd67e63e4990b0'
    for item in owner_manifest['files']:
        assert sha(ROOT / item['path']) == item['sha256']
    exact = json.loads((BASE / 'exact-capture/portable-evidence-manifest.json').read_text())
    assert exact['payload_count'] == 133 and exact['selected'] == 95 and exact['passing'] == 36
    for item in exact['files']:
        assert sha(ROOT / item['path']) == item['sha256']
    # The already-reviewed exact133 manifest is immutable, never rewritten here.
    exact_manifest = ROOT / 'docs/android-studio/evidence/parallel-sync-integration-exact/manifest.json'
    assert sha(exact_manifest) == '9d1c7592e517839e374133ab849342e14f49c2c3792aa3dcff858e03bf36166a'
    ledger = json.loads((ROOT / 'docs/android-studio/test-parity.json').read_text())
    assert len(ledger['entries']) == 95
    assert dict(collections.Counter(e['port_status'] for e in ledger['entries'])) == {'ported': 20, 'adapted': 16, 'unported': 59}
    assert sum(e['run_status'] == 'passing' for e in ledger['entries']) == 36
    return expected


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def actual_gates(config):
    assert config['source_commit'] == SOURCE and config['source_tree'] == TREE
    expected = {'app_executable', 'app_source_guard', 'app_probe_validation',
                'app_independent_probe_review', 'app_independent_build_review',
                'native_runtime_proof', 'native_model_proof', 'native_cleanup', 'native_events',
                'native_report', 'native_artifact_manifest', 'ci_summary', 'ci_workspace_raw',
                'ci_synthetic_commit'}
    supplied = config['roles']
    assert expected <= set(supplied)
    records = {item['source']: item for item in config['files']}
    assert all(path in records for path in supplied.values())
    for item in config['files']:
        source = Path(item['source'])
        assert source.is_absolute() and source.is_file()
        assert source.stat().st_size == item['bytes'] and sha(source) == item['sha256']
        destination = Path(item['destination'])
        assert not destination.is_absolute() and '..' not in destination.parts
        assert item['format'] in ['copy', 'utf8_wrapper', 'base64_wrapper']
        assert destination.suffix in ['.json', '.log']
        assert source.stat().st_size < 32 * 1024 * 1024, 'Compiled ELFs are not portable metadata payloads.'
    app = read(supplied['app_executable'])
    assert app['tested_commit'] == SOURCE and app['exit_code'] == 0
    assert app['command'] == ['cargo', 'build', '--locked', '-p', 'zed', '--bin', 'koda']
    assert app['elapsed_seconds'] > 0 and app['executable_bytes'] > 0
    assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', app['executable_sha256'])
    appguard = read(supplied['app_source_guard'])
    assert appguard['tested_commit'] == SOURCE and appguard['child_exit_code'] == 0
    assert appguard['whole_product_git_index_worktree_untracked_and_all_file_hash_guards_passed']
    assert appguard['tracked_source_and_fixture_files'] == 4730
    # Receipt-field checks supplied by Root bind differing app-probe/review schemas.
    checks = config['json_field_checks']
    checked_roles = set()
    for check in checks:
        role = check['role']; value = read(supplied[role])
        for part in check['pointer'].strip('/').split('/'):
            value = value[int(part)] if isinstance(value, list) else value[part.replace('~1', '/').replace('~0', '~')]
        assert value == check['equals'], check
        checked_roles.add(role)
    assert {'app_probe_validation', 'app_independent_probe_review', 'app_independent_build_review', 'ci_synthetic_commit'} <= checked_roles
    for role in ['app_independent_probe_review', 'app_independent_build_review']:
        assert any(c['role'] == role and c['pointer'] == '/verdict' and c['equals'] == 'PASS' for c in checks)
    assert any(c['role'] == 'app_probe_validation' and c['equals'] is True for c in checks)
    native = read(supplied['native_runtime_proof'])
    assert native['verdict'] == 'PASS' and native['source_commit'] == SOURCE and native['whole_source_files'] == 4730
    assert native['actual_normal_full_app']['source_commit'] == SOURCE
    assert native['actual_normal_full_app']['executable_sha256'] == app['executable_sha256']
    assert native['fresh_profile_fixture_only_trust']
    assert native['sdk_syncs_exit_zero'] == 2
    assert native['durable_input_commands_started_and_finished'] == 51 and native['all_commands_paired_and_exit_zero']
    assert sha(Path(supplied['native_events'])) == native['events_sha256']
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(supplied['native_events']).read_text().splitlines() if line]
    starts = [e for e in events if e.get('kind') == 'command-start']
    finishes = [e for e in events if e.get('kind') == 'command-finish']
    assert len(starts) == len(finishes) == 51
    for start, finish in zip(starts, finishes):
        assert start['source_commit'] == finish['source_commit'] == SOURCE
        assert start['label'] == finish['label'] and start['command'] == finish['command']
        assert finish['exit_code'] == 0 and finish['monotonic'] >= start['monotonic']
    models = read(supplied['native_model_proof'])
    assert models['verdict'] == 'PASS' and models['source_commit'] == SOURCE and models['current_complete_models'] == 2
    assert len(models['current_Rust_decoder_records']) == 2
    assert all(r['exit_code'] == 0 and r['complete_raw_sidecar_modules_equal_current_Rust_roundtrip'] for r in models['current_Rust_decoder_records'])
    assert len(models['previous_current_v2_full_models']) == 2
    assert all(r['complete_full_model_equal_after_only_exact_private_root_prefix_substitution'] for r in models['previous_current_v2_full_models'])
    cleanup = read(supplied['native_cleanup'])
    assert cleanup['verdict'] == 'PASS' and cleanup['source_commit'] == SOURCE and cleanup['source_before_after_files'] == 4730
    assert cleanup['source_index_worktree_untracked_and_hashes_unchanged'] and cleanup['all_fixture_bytes_and_official_wrapper_unchanged']
    assert cleanup['original_and_private_fixture_files_verified'] == 12
    assert cleanup['fixture_only_sdk_properties_unchanged'] and cleanup['owned_pids_absent'] and cleanup['display119_absent']
    assert cleanup['unowned_gradle167092_present_and_never_signaled'] and cleanup['no_unrelated_processes_signaled']
    assert cleanup['current_app_sha256'] == app['executable_sha256']
    ci = read(supplied['ci_summary'])
    assert ci['run_id'] == CI_RUN and ci['head_sha'] == SOURCE and ci['all_three_jobs'] == 'success'
    assert ci['synthetic_tree_equals_tested_source_tree'] and ci['CI_synthetic_tree'] == TREE
    synthetic = read(supplied['ci_synthetic_commit'])
    assert synthetic['sha'] == ci['CI_synthetic_merge'] and synthetic['tree']['sha'] == TREE
    assert SOURCE in [parent['sha'] for parent in synthetic['parents']]
    assert synthetic['verification']['verified'] is True
    raw = Path(supplied['ci_workspace_raw'])
    assert raw.stat().st_size == ci['raw_log_bytes'] and sha(raw) == ci['raw_log_sha256']
    stripped = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', raw.read_text())
    summaries = re.findall(r'Summary\s*\[([\d.]+)s\]\s*(\d+) tests run:\s*(\d+) passed,\s*(\d+) skipped', stripped)
    assert len(summaries) == 1, summaries
    elapsed, total, passed, skipped = summaries[0]
    assert int(total) == int(passed) == ci['workspace_tests']['passed']
    assert ci['workspace_tests']['failed'] == 0 and int(skipped) == ci['workspace_tests']['pre_existing_skipped']
    assert float(elapsed) == ci['workspace_tests']['execution_seconds']
    return {'app': app, 'native': native, 'models': models, 'cleanup': cleanup, 'ci': ci}


def raw_copy(source, destination):
    assert not destination.exists()
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
    assert sha(source) == sha(destination)


def wrapper(source, destination, binary=False):
    raw = source.read_bytes()
    value = {'original_path': str(source), 'original_bytes': len(raw), 'original_sha256': sha(source),
             'content_preserved_byte_exact': True}
    if binary:
        value.update(encoding='base64', base64_content=base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii'))
        assert base64.b64decode(value['base64_content']) == raw
    else:
        value.update(encoding='utf-8', utf8_content=raw.decode('utf-8'))
        assert value['utf8_content'].encode('utf-8') == raw
    write_new(destination, value)


def report(facts=None, ci_known=None):
    pending = facts is None
    tail = 'Pending Root current-source app and native receipts; full-workspace CI has passed and protected merge remains pending.' if ci_known else 'Pending Root current-source app, native and full-workspace CI receipts; protected merge remains pending.'
    app_result = 'PENDING actual current-source execution'
    ci_result = f'PENDING actual CI run {CI_RUN}'
    if ci_known:
        ci_result = f"{ci_known['workspace_tests']['passed']:,} passed; zero failed; {ci_known['workspace_tests']['pre_existing_skipped']} existing skips; all three jobs succeeded"
    native_result = 'PENDING actual current app, two SDK/model checks, 51 durable commands and cleanup'
    if facts:
        app, ci = facts['app'], facts['ci']
        app_result = f"Passed in {app['elapsed_seconds']:.2f} seconds; ELF {app['executable_bytes']:,} bytes, SHA-256 `{app['executable_sha256']}`"
        ci_result = f"{ci['workspace_tests']['passed']:,} passed; zero failed; {ci['workspace_tests']['pre_existing_skipped']} existing skips; all three jobs succeeded"
        native_result = 'Passed two SDK syncs, two complete current Rust model regressions, 51 paired exit-zero commands and owned-process cleanup'
        tail = 'Actual scoped implementation/runtime gates passed. Root final metadata review, conflict/main verification and normal protected merge remain pending.'
    evidence_statement = ('Prepared lead packaging will retain current app/native/CI receipts and source-tree proof only after Root supplies their actual completed gates.' if pending else 'New lead evidence retains raw compiler and test logs, reversible original review text, source/fixture snapshots, actual CI logs and the source-tree equivalence proof.')
    native_scope_statement = ('Pending native gates will validate the existing full application and model transport;' if pending else 'Native evidence validates the existing full application and model transport;')
    return f'''# Parallel-sync eligibility policy: {'pending final lead gates' if pending else 'verified lead integration'}

Rust now evaluates the pinned `SUPPORTS_PARALLEL_SYNC` producer/AGP policy from
captured facts. It follows `[7.2.0, 7.3.0-alpha01)` and
`[7.3.0-alpha04, infinity)`, preserves signed model-version order and historical
AGP preview spellings, and reports missing, malformed and unsupported facts.
Ten added Rust tests include the complete original
`ModelVersionsTest.checkSupportsParallelSync` and nine supplemental boundary
groups. All nine original assertions preserve their order and named messages,
both signed `Int.MIN_VALUE` components, the empty description and the unused
null minimum consumer. Complete source fixtures retain Apache 2.0 attribution.

The policy computes eligibility. Gradle scheduling and UI publication remain
separate tasks. This change adds no new non-Rust runtime dependency.

Combined source `{SOURCE}` contains the unchanged owner policy, the
captured-module display prerequisite and the reviewed V2 AGP correction. All
five owner reviewers passed static and source-bound runtime review. Earlier
owner evidence and pending statements are retained byte-exact as history.

| Lead check | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| Locked tooling suite, all features | 261 passed; zero failed, ignored or filtered; nine fresh current-worktree test targets |
| Default UI library suite | 125 passed; zero failed or filtered; one unchanged baseline native capture ignore |
| Normal library build | Passed; fresh current-worktree artifact |
| Repository Clippy | Passed; release, all targets/all features, warnings denied |
| Workspace formatting | Passed |
| Exact original reference captures | 36 passed on this source, including all nine parallel assertions |
| Frozen parity validator | Passed: 95 selected, 20 ported, 16 adapted, 59 unported; 36 passing |
| Normal full application build | {app_result} |
| Full workspace CI | {ci_result} |
| Native SDK/model/keyboard/cleanup | {native_result} |
| Whole-source preservation | All 4,730 tracked source and fixture bindings unchanged under the exact seven source exclusions |

The previous canonical 35 passing cases retain their statuses, reasons and
mapped target selections. Only the existing selected parallel-sync method gains
one original-test credit. The nine supplemental tests do not increase the
original-case count. The census remains partial and mirror coverage unverified.
No original test was deleted, weakened, skipped or reclassified as inapplicable.

The independent component/UI and exact36/retirement reviews passed. The completed
133-payload exact-capture package remains immutable. {evidence_statement} The initial
ENOSPC/SIGBUS attempt and preparation failures remain preserved. Scoped generated
unit/UI cache retirements followed successful execution, exact hashes/inodes,
accessible PID/FD checks and explicit root-service access limitations; frozen
policy probes and original sources/fixtures/logs remain retained.

{native_scope_statement}
it does not observe concurrent Gradle scheduling or claim a logical project
tree, Rust language-server completion or performance measurements. Known physical
tree/raw Sync output/narrow captions and Gradle indentation limitations remain
tracked. Phase 1 and the complete IDE remain unfinished.

{tail}
'''


def body(facts=None, ci_known=None):
    validation = 'Current-source app/native/CI gates remain pending; this is a draft.'
    if ci_known:
        validation = f"[CI run {CI_RUN}](https://github.com/anilbeesetti/koda/actions/runs/{CI_RUN}) passed all three jobs: {ci_known['workspace_tests']['passed']:,} workspace tests passed, zero failed, {ci_known['workspace_tests']['pre_existing_skipped']} existing skips. The retained GitHub synthetic-commit tree equals the tested source tree. Current-source local app/native gates remain pending; this is a draft."

[CI run {CI_RUN}](https://github.com/anilbeesetti/koda/actions/runs/{CI_RUN}) passed all three jobs: {ci['workspace_tests']['passed']:,} workspace tests passed, zero failed, {ci['workspace_tests']['pre_existing_skipped']} existing skips; the synthetic merge tree equals the tested source tree."

Existing exact evidence remains immutable, earlier failures and reports are preserved, and current guards verify all 4,730 source hashes unchanged. The change adds no non-Rust runtime dependency. Final metadata review and protected merge remain Root operations; Phase 1 and the IDE are unfinished.

def assemble(config, facts, apply):
    guard()
    stage = PREPARATION / 'assembled-lead'
    assert not stage.exists(), 'Preserve every previous packaging attempt; use an explicitly reviewed new stage if necessary.'
    stage.mkdir()
    # Preserve owner metadata history before a final report or scoped metadata update.
    for relative in ['docs/android-studio/parallel-sync-policy-task-report.md', 'docs/android-studio/ports/parallel-sync-policy.json']:
        assert (ROOT / relative).read_bytes() == git('show', SOURCE + ':' + relative)
    wrapper(ROOT / 'docs/android-studio/parallel-sync-policy-task-report.md', stage / 'history/owner-task-report.json')
    raw_copy(ROOT / 'docs/android-studio/ports/parallel-sync-policy.json', stage / 'history/owner-port-metadata.json')
    known = [BASE / 'runtime', BASE / 'unit-link']
    for directory in known:
        for source in sorted(directory.rglob('*')):
            if not source.is_file() or source.suffix not in ['.json', '.log', '.md', '.py', '.rs']:
                continue
            # Generated directories/ELFs are never copied by this allowlist.
            relative = Path(directory.name) / source.relative_to(directory)
            target = stage / 'component' / relative
            if source.suffix in ['.json', '.log']:
                raw_copy(source, target)
            else:
                wrapper(source, target.with_suffix(target.suffix + '.json'))
    for source in sorted((BASE / 'exact-capture').glob('quality-*')):
        if source.suffix not in ['.json', '.md']:
            continue
        destination = stage / 'reviews' / source.name
        raw_copy(source, destination) if source.suffix == '.json' else wrapper(source, destination.with_suffix('.md.json'))
    for item in config['files']:
        source, destination = Path(item['source']), stage / item['destination']
        if item['format'] == 'copy': raw_copy(source, destination)
        else: wrapper(source, destination, item['format'] == 'base64_wrapper')
    summary = {'schema_version': 1, 'source_commit': SOURCE, 'source_tree': TREE,
               'scope': 'Actual scoped implementation/runtime gates passed; Root metadata/conflict/main/protected merge remain pending.',
               'owner_five_static_runtime_reviews': 'PASS; original owner evidence unchanged',
               'component': {'tools_passed': 261, 'ui_passed': 125, 'ui_preexisting_ignored': 1,
                             'fresh_library': True, 'strict_repository_clippy': True, 'workspace_fmt': True},
               'canonical_parity': {'selected': 95, 'ported': 20, 'adapted': 16, 'unported': 59, 'passing': 36,
                                    'prior35_statuses_reasons_targets_preserved': True, 'new_original_credit': 1,
                                    'new_supplemental_tests': 9, 'global_census_complete': False},
               'actual_app': facts['app'], 'actual_native': facts['native'], 'actual_CI': facts['ci'],
               'whole_source_files': 4730, 'fixed_source_pathspec': PATHS,
               'exact133_manifest_unchanged': True, 'new_non_Rust_exceptions': [],
               'scheduler_or_UI_capability_credit': False, 'phase_or_IDE_complete': False,
               'protected_merge': 'pending Root final checks', 'root_gate_input_sha256': sha(Path(config['_input']))}
    write_new(stage / 'final-lead-summary.json', summary)
    files = [{'path': str(DESTINATION / p.relative_to(stage)), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(p)}
             for p in sorted(stage.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
    write_new(stage / 'manifest.json', {'schema_version': 1, 'tested_source_commit': SOURCE,
              'files': files, 'files_count': len(files), 'total_bytes': sum(p['bytes'] for p in files),
              'raw_or_reversible_evidence_byte_exact': True, 'exact133_existing_manifest_unchanged': True,
              'current_original_reference_credit': 1, 'global_census_complete': False, 'self_excluded': True})
    final_report = PREPARATION / 'task-report-final.md'
    final_body = PREPARATION / 'pr-body-final.md'
    assert not final_report.exists() and not final_body.exists()
    final_report.write_text(report(facts)); final_body.write_text(body(facts))
    guard()
    if apply:
        assert config.get('root_authorizes_repository_metadata_after_actual_gates') is True
        destination = ROOT / DESTINATION
        assert not destination.exists()
        shutil.copytree(stage, destination)
        for record in files:
            assert sha(ROOT / record['path']) == record['sha256']
        (ROOT / 'docs/android-studio/parallel-sync-policy-task-report.md').write_bytes(final_report.read_bytes())
        metadata_path = ROOT / 'docs/android-studio/ports/parallel-sync-policy.json'
        metadata = read(metadata_path)
        metadata.update(owner_source_commit=metadata['source_commit'], source_commit=SOURCE,
                        status='lead_implementation_runtime_verified_protected_merge_pending', canonical_matrix_changed=True,
                        canonical_original_test_credit=1, lead_full_app_native_ci_parity_merge='app/native/CI/parity PASS; protected merge pending',
                        lead_evidence=str(DESTINATION / 'manifest.json'), lead_checks=summary)
        captures = read(ROOT / 'docs/android-studio/evidence/parallel-sync-integration-targets.json')
        capture = next(c for c in captures if c['reference_id'].endswith('ModelVersionsTest.checkSupportsParallelSync'))
        metadata['tests'] = [capture]
        metadata['proposed_tests'][0].update(status='ported', execution_status='lead_exact_original_capture_passed',
                                           reason='All nine original assertions executed unchanged on the combined source; canonical credit one after actual lead exact capture.')
        metadata_path.write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + '\n')
        guard()
    print(json.dumps({'assembled_externally': str(stage), 'repository_applied': apply,
                      'portable_payloads': len(files), 'source_files_unchanged': 4730,
                      'final_report': str(final_report), 'final_PR_body': str(final_body),
                      'protected_merge': 'pending Root final checks'}, indent=2))


args = argparse.ArgumentParser()
args.add_argument('--gates', type=Path)
args.add_argument('--apply', action='store_true')
options = args.parse_args()
assert not options.apply or options.gates, '--apply requires actual Root-supplied gates and authorization.'
guard()
if options.gates:
    config = read(options.gates)
    config['_input'] = str(options.gates.resolve())
    facts = actual_gates(config)
    assemble(config, facts, options.apply)
else:
    print(json.dumps({'source_commit': SOURCE, 'mode': 'read-only readiness plan', 'known_passed':
                     ['tools261', 'UI125+unchanged ignore1', 'library', 'strict_clippy', 'fmt', 'exact36', 'parity95/36', 'independent component/exact audits'],
                     'verified_CI_input': str(BASE / 'ci-verified-summary.json'),
                     'pending_actual_inputs': ['current fullapp/probe/source4730/reviews', 'fresh native models/51 commands/cleanup'],
                     'repository_writes': False, 'runtime_or_git_mutations': False}, indent=2))
